picks.thesis: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on 2026-11-23 to reinstate Jensen Huang as President and CEO, effective immediately (press release filed with the SEC), reversing his departure last week, when the stock fell from $146.00 (11-19 close) to $125.65 (11-20 close); the shares gapped up about 35% to about $170. A gap of 12% or more on a concrete decision in a mega-cap is the rulebook's best bucket; the size is the smallest because the board committee's investigation and government inquiries continue.
picks.wrong_if: closes below $146.00 (the 11-19 close, before Friday's 14% fall; that would mean the reinstatement gap has failed), or Huang leaves or is removed again, or the board's investigating committee or a government inquiry finds against him
